WITH tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, card_scheme, eur_amount, is_credit, aci,
    IF(issuing_country = acquirer_country, 1, 0) AS intra
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.payments`
  WHERE merchant = 'Belles_cookbook_store' AND year = 2023 AND day_of_year BETWEEN 91 AND 120
),
matches AS (
  SELECT tx.psp_reference, tx.card_scheme, f.ID,
    f.fixed_amount + f.rate * tx.eur_amount / 10000 AS fee
  FROM tx
  JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees` f ON f.card_scheme = tx.card_scheme
  WHERE (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.account_type), 0) = 0 OR 'R' IN UNNEST(f.account_type))
    AND (f.capture_delay IS NULL OR f.capture_delay = '<3')
    AND (f.monthly_fraud_level IS NULL OR f.monthly_fraud_level = '>8.3%')
    AND (f.monthly_volume IS NULL OR f.monthly_volume = '100k-1m')
    AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.merchant_category_code), 0) = 0 OR 5942 IN UNNEST(f.merchant_category_code))
    AND (f.is_credit IS NULL OR f.is_credit = tx.is_credit)
    AND (COALESCE(ARRAY_LENGTH(f.aci), 0) = 0 OR tx.aci IN UNNEST(f.aci))
    AND (f.intracountry IS NULL OR f.intracountry = tx.intra)
),
per_tx AS (
  SELECT psp_reference, card_scheme, COUNT(*) AS n_rules, MIN(fee) AS fee_min, MAX(fee) AS fee_max
  FROM matches GROUP BY psp_reference, card_scheme
)
SELECT
  tx.card_scheme,
  COUNT(*) AS tx_count,
  COUNTIF(p.n_rules IS NULL) AS unmatched_tx,
  MAX(p.n_rules) AS max_rules_per_tx,
  ROUND(SUM(p.fee_min), 2) AS total_fee_min,
  ROUND(SUM(p.fee_max), 2) AS total_fee_max
FROM tx
LEFT JOIN per_tx p ON p.psp_reference = tx.psp_reference AND p.card_scheme = tx.card_scheme
GROUP BY tx.card_scheme
ORDER BY total_fee_min
